'''Stuncuffs''' were restraint devices made of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] used to control [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]]. Stuncuffs were capable of delivering a electrical charge to the detainee, effectively incapacitating them and allowing the prisoners to be restrained.

==Description==
Stuncuffs were a common restraint device used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to control [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] and captives. Stuncuffs were generally used for prisoners who were considered to be high-risk threats. They were functionally similar to [[Magnacuffs/Legends|magnacuffs]],<ref name="EGWT" /> featuring [[Magnetic field projector|magnetic field generators]], but they also incorporated [[stun filament]]s that delivered an electrical [[Stun/Legends|stun]] charge into the cuffs. Triggered remotely, stuncuffs delivered a paralyzing jolt of energy into the prisoner<ref name="NEGWT" /> to render them unconscious. Stuncuffs could be placed on detainees around their arms or legs.<ref name="NEGWT" />
